entratar

Overview

[!NOTE] entratar is still in early stages of development.

entratar provides a robust, production grade API client library for Entrata, a leading property management system provider vendor for real estate property management companies.

See the package documentation for the full library reference and the official Entrata Developer Portal for more details.

Installation

You can install the development version of entratar from GitHub with:

# using pak & github
pak::pak("jimbrig/entratar")

or via R Universe with:

install.packages("entratar", repos = c("https://jimbrig.r-universe.dev", getOption("repos")))

Usage 

# can set envvars before loading the library to auto-detect and configure them
Sys.setenv("ENTRATA_API_KEY" = "...")
Sys.setenv("ENTRATA_API_ORG" = "...")

library(entratar)

# or set the interactively:
entrata_config(api_key = "...", org = "...")

# check status via /status getStatus
entrata_status()

Endpoints

  • /status
  • /appinfo
  • /applications
  • /properties
  • /propertyunits
  • /leases
  • /leasingunits
  • /financial
  • /pricing
  • /reports & /queue
